findings.summary: The alert issue body always says 'The full test suite failed'. Since the alert job now also fires when only gate-scripts fails, the issue text will mislead the triager. Consider mentioning the gate-scripts job and which steps failed, or branching the body on needs.*.result. The title is unchanged so dedup still works.

findings.summary: The DoR gate step feeds an empty verdicts file to dor-pr-has-violations. It only checks that the CLI runs and prints valid JSON, so it is a smoke test, not a check of real task verdicts. Acceptable, but the step name or comment could say so.

findings.summary: The doctor check runs npx backlog-drift@0.1.3 check --json on every doctor run, which can need network access and be slow. A failure degrades quietly to pass. The version pin is hardcoded in two places and could drift.

findings.summary: The new gate-scripts job has no job-level permissions block, so it inherits workflow-level contents: read + issues: write while running npx backlog-drift@0.1.3 from the npm registry. It never needs issues: write. Suggest permissions: { contents: read } on the job.
